Under the direction of the Associate Dean of the Division of Continuing Education (DCE), the Director of Academic Programs & Program Innovation is responsible for overseeing the activities of public education professionals, academic programs, and management of unit’s day to day activities. The Director is responsible for ensuring that all programs are learner-centered, aligned to industry and/or professional association needs and adhere to established academic and service quality standards.. The Director, in consultation with the Associate Dean, establishes short and long-term goals and priorities for domestic open enrollment programs and collaborates on program development andoversees the delivery of courses, workshops and programs.

Establishes goals, expectations and objectives and evaluates the performance of the academic programs team, including Program Managers and indirectly, instructional designers and program coordinators. Leads, supports and motivates the Program Managers, ensuring close attention is paid to curriculum quality and maintenance, industry alignment, instructor performance, relationships with professional associations and overall learner and instructor experience.

. Recommends changes to department policies and practices. Responsible for collaborating across teams and cultivating and maintaining relationships with internal and external partners. The Director continually engages in problem-solving associated with the day-to-day operations, including course related issues, instructor hiring, coaching and management and learner issues. The Director also provides support and leadership of strategic initiatives, adding insight and expertise on topics related to academic programming, instructor professional development, course development and innovative course and learning models.

The Director is an active participant in the AP governance process, preparing proposals,evaluating market viability, advising on format and ensuring that DCE has the required resources (human and financial) for the development and renewal of a high volume DCE courses. The Director has the responsibility of supervising and supporting the preparation of approval packages for certificate programs, MOUs, and the creation and dissemination of all supporting documentation for the Academic Program Council. Responsible for communicating program changes and updates to keystakeholders and divisional wide to ensure understanding and clear expectations.
The Director is expected to build internal and external relationships and partnerships to strengthen and grow programs, explore new opportunities, and attend business meetings and events.
